strategies.name: Cash preservation
strategies.allocation: $20M held in reserve; $4M Consumer, $3M Enterprise, $3M AI
strategies.description: Invests $10M a quarter ($4M Consumer, $3M Enterprise, $3M AI/Product) and holds $20M in reserve; Balanced Marketplace

strategies.name: Adaptive (evidence-responsive)
strategies.allocation: Balanced Q1, then shifts with market evidence (Test Lab "evidence-responsive")
strategies.description: Explores broadly in Q1, then follows the evidence: shifts toward Enterprise + AI when AI disruption and enterprise AI demand appear, keeps Consumer defended, commits to AI-powered Enterprise at Q4.

scenarios.label: Authored arc
scenarios.description: The production scenario: AI disruption from Q2, Q5 contract, Q6 recession, Q7 crisis, Q8 final decision.

scenarios.label: Consumer weaker
scenarios.description: Consumer demand ×0.9 and commoditization +0.15 from Q2.

scenarios.label: Consumer stronger
scenarios.description: Consumer demand ×1.1, commoditization halved and CAC pressure −0.1 from Q2.

scenarios.label: Enterprise boom
scenarios.description: Enterprise demand ×1.2 and enterprise AI demand ×1.15 from Q2.

scenarios.label: Enterprise slump
scenarios.description: Enterprise demand ×0.85 and enterprise AI demand ×0.9 from Q2.

scenarios.label: AI boom
scenarios.description: AI-native demand ×1.3 and enterprise AI demand ×1.1 from Q2.

scenarios.label: No AI disruption
scenarios.description: From Q2: consumer demand +0.1 (max 1, the recession dip remains), commoditization 0, CAC pressure 1; AI-native and enterprise AI demand 1 (capacities as authored).

scenarios.label: Severe recession
scenarios.description: Macro pressure 1.0 / 0.8 / 0.4 in Q6–Q8 and all segment demand ×0.9 in Q6–Q7.

scenarios.label: No recession
scenarios.description: Q6–Q8 macro pressure 0.1 and demand held at Q5 levels (the Q6 response decision still occurs).

candidates.label: Moderate the AI adoption reward
candidates.rationale: AI-native new monetization above the starting adoption level: $0.08M → $0.05M per adoption point per quarter. AI-native revenue currently compounds by $6–8M a quarter once adoption passes ~70, the largest growth flow in the model.

candidates.label: Enterprise capability converts to bookings
candidates.rationale: Enterprise win rate per point of relative capability 0.08 → 0.30 and pipeline inflow amplitude 1.2 → 3.0. Enterprise capability 30 → 120 currently lifts the win rate ~4 points and Enterprise revenue only $40M → $46M by Q8.

candidates.label: Lower Enterprise run-cost commitment
candidates.rationale: Delivery/CS commitment 4% → 2% of investment per quarter for 6 quarters.

candidates.label: University pipeline responds to Credential
candidates.rationale: University pipeline inflow amplitude 0.8 → 4.0 and resolution 0.2 → 0.4. Credential 40 → 120 currently grows the pipeline 24 → 42 and University revenue not at all within eight quarters.
